question: What is the value of(4 x²+9 y²+12 x y)/(144)?
solution:
**Concept Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

**(4 x²+9 y²+12 x y)/(144)**

⇒ **((2x)²+(3y)²+2times 2times 3times x y)/((12)²)**

⇒ **((2x+3y)²)/((12)²)**

⇒ **(((2x+3y))/(12))²**

⇒ ((2x)/(12)+(3y)/(12))²

⇒ ((x)/(6)+(y)/(4))²

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
